notes: Measured on cluster `admin@cherry-bench`, namespace exp-hpa-scaling. CPU-burner Deployment (150m CPU request, no CPU limit, /burn busy-loop that yields the GIL) behind a Service, autoscaling/v2 HPA target 50% CPU min=1 max=6 with scaleUp stabilizationWindow=0. T0=load start (8 concurrent /burn?ms=100 loops from a generator pod). scale_up_latency_s = (first time readyReplicas>1) - T0. time_to_stabilize_s = (replica count unchanged for 30s, while >1) - T0. peak_cpu_utilization_pct is the max HPA-observed CPU% (HPA sees average across replicas, so it can read near 50% once spread). scale_down_latency_s = (back to 1 replica) - load-stop; HPA scaleDown stabilizationWindow=60s, capped at 300s observation.
